value.rationale: Independent calibration errors of locally stochastic cyclic averaging create a genuine dimension-dependent boundary between uniform reduction and possible amplification of global pairwise dispersion. The theorem gives a complete sharp robustness radius across all cycle sizes and exact minimax Gini decrease per unit oscillation, with a constructive one-impulse optimality witness. It goes beyond the fixed-parameter cut identity and gives a reusable safety margin for a canonical family of local Markov operators.
